name: service-packages
title: Service packages
description: Fixed-scope packages for agencies and consultants: the price, how long it takes, what you get and what you have to provide, in cards that line up row by row.
docs: Pass two to four packages (an id, a name, a summary, the price as text, an optional from flag and price note, the duration, the deliverables, what the client provides, an action and an optional featured flag), a title, an optional description and a note for VAT and payment terms. Prices are real text in tabular figures and the duration is a visible fact. The you provide panel, access, content and a decision-maker, is what makes it a service package rather than a software plan; it is joined into a sentence in the locale you pass. One package can be marked featured, which gets a stronger border and a badge. The cards share their rows through a subgrid, so the prices, the durations, the dividers, the deliverables, the panels and the buttons line up from one card to the next, even when one price note runs to two lines, and the columns follow the count so no package is left alone in a row. The action is an object with a label and either an href or an onClick, and a long label wraps instead of spilling out of its card. labels translates the fixed words.
